PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS

have / has been + verb-ing

We use it for an activity that started in the past and is still continuing, or has recently stopped and has a result now.

I have been studying for two hours.
Her hands are dirty because she has been painting.
FOR = a period of time
for two hours · for a week
SINCE = a starting point
since Monday · since 4 o'clock
